# Rev AI

Affordable, accurate, easy-to-use speech-to-text solutions powered by people and A.I working together. Rev offers transcripts, captions, subtitles, and more.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/rev/.

## Actions

- **Delete Job By ID**: Delete a completed transcription job and its data.
- **Get Account** (read-only): Retrieve developer account details.
- **Get Captions** (read-only): Retrieve captions (SRT or VTT) for a completed Rev.ai transcription job.
- **Get Job by ID** (read-only): Fetch details of a transcription job by its ID.
- **Get List of Jobs** (read-only): Get list of transcription jobs from the past 30 days.
- **Get Transcript by ID** (read-only): Retrieve the transcript of a completed Rev.ai job.
- **Start Stream Transcription**: Start a WebSocket transcription stream.
- **Submit Transcription Job**: Submit a new transcription job.
- **Delete Custom Vocabulary**: Delete a completed custom vocabulary and its data.
- **Get Custom Vocabulary Details** (read-only): Retrieve custom vocabulary processing details.
- **Submit Custom Vocabulary**: Submit a custom vocabulary for improved speech recognition.
